protocol: Neodiprion saw (first valvula) landmark + semilandmark protocol
orientation: protocol frame: apex LEFT, serrulae (teeth) UP; images are mirrored left-right when needed and flipped top to bottom in software (tools/frame.py)
calibration: per image, from its own burned-in scale bar (tools/scalebar.py; analysis/data/calibration.csv)

S01.name: Apex
S01.definition: Distal tip of the saw: the point of maximum curvature where the ventral and dorsal outlines meet.

V1.name: Annulus 1, ventral end
V1.definition: Ventral end of the dark band of annulus 1. The ventral margin here is pale membrane, so the point is often a few um inside the outline; place it at the end of the band, not on the membrane.

V2.name: Annulus 2, ventral end
V2.definition: Where the dark band of annulus 2 meets the ventral (toothed) outline, i.e. the proximal base of serrula 2.

V3.name: Annulus 3, ventral end
V3.definition: Where the dark band of annulus 3 meets the ventral (toothed) outline, i.e. the proximal base of serrula 3.

V4.name: Annulus 4, ventral end
V4.definition: Where the dark band of annulus 4 meets the ventral (toothed) outline, i.e. the proximal base of serrula 4.

V5.name: Annulus 5, ventral end
V5.definition: Where the dark band of annulus 5 meets the ventral (toothed) outline, i.e. the proximal base of serrula 5.

V6.name: Annulus 6, ventral end
V6.definition: Where the dark band of annulus 6 meets the ventral (toothed) outline, i.e. the proximal base of serrula 6.

V7.name: Annulus 7, ventral end
V7.definition: Where the dark band of annulus 7 meets the ventral (toothed) outline, i.e. the proximal base of serrula 7.

T2.name: Serrula 2, tip
T2.definition: Distal tip of serrula 2: the most protruding point of the tooth lobe that lies distal to V2, measured perpendicular to the line V2 -> V3 (not "lowest in the image").

T3.name: Serrula 3, tip
T3.definition: Distal tip of serrula 3: the most protruding point of the tooth lobe that lies distal to V3, measured perpendicular to the line V3 -> V4 (not "lowest in the image").

T4.name: Serrula 4, tip
T4.definition: Distal tip of serrula 4: the most protruding point of the tooth lobe that lies distal to V4, measured perpendicular to the line V4 -> V5 (not "lowest in the image").

R1.name: Annulus 1 x rachis
R1.definition: Where the distal (toothed) edge of annulus 1 crosses the ventral margin of the rachis (the dark longitudinal strip).

R2.name: Annulus 2 x rachis
R2.definition: Where the distal (toothed) edge of annulus 2 crosses the ventral margin of the rachis (the dark longitudinal strip).

R3.name: Annulus 3 x rachis
R3.definition: Where the distal (toothed) edge of annulus 3 crosses the ventral margin of the rachis (the dark longitudinal strip).

R4.name: Annulus 4 x rachis
R4.definition: Where the distal (toothed) edge of annulus 4 crosses the ventral margin of the rachis (the dark longitudinal strip).

R5.name: Annulus 5 x rachis
R5.definition: Where the distal (toothed) edge of annulus 5 crosses the ventral margin of the rachis (the dark longitudinal strip).

R6.name: Annulus 6 x rachis
R6.definition: Where the distal (toothed) edge of annulus 6 crosses the ventral margin of the rachis (the dark longitudinal strip).

R7.name: Annulus 7 x rachis
R7.definition: Where the distal (toothed) edge of annulus 7 crosses the ventral margin of the rachis (the dark longitudinal strip).

D1.name: Annulus 1, dorsal end
D1.definition: Where annulus 1 crosses the dorsal margin of the rachis. A pale cuticle strip lies above the rachis, so this point is inside the saw, not on its outline.

D2.name: Annulus 2, dorsal end
D2.definition: Where annulus 2 crosses the dorsal margin of the rachis. A pale cuticle strip lies above the rachis, so this point is inside the saw, not on its outline.

D3.name: Annulus 3, dorsal end
D3.definition: Dorsal end of the dark band of annulus 3, above the rachis. It lies BELOW the dorsal outline (a pale cuticle strip separates them); do not place it on the outline.

D4.name: Annulus 4, dorsal end
D4.definition: Dorsal end of the dark band of annulus 4, above the rachis. It lies BELOW the dorsal outline (a pale cuticle strip separates them); do not place it on the outline.

D5.name: Annulus 5, dorsal end
D5.definition: Dorsal end of the dark band of annulus 5, above the rachis. It lies BELOW the dorsal outline (a pale cuticle strip separates them); do not place it on the outline.

D6.name: Annulus 6, dorsal end
D6.definition: Dorsal end of the dark band of annulus 6, above the rachis. It lies BELOW the dorsal outline (a pale cuticle strip separates them); do not place it on the outline.

D7.name: Annulus 7, dorsal end
D7.definition: Dorsal end of the dark band of annulus 7, above the rachis. It lies BELOW the dorsal outline (a pale cuticle strip separates them); do not place it on the outline.

old_dropped.4: notch after annulus 2: 95% of its inter-observer error lies along the outline -> ventral semilandmarks
old_dropped.7: notch after annulus 3: 86% along the outline -> ventral semilandmarks
old_dropped.13: annulus 8 ventral end: last annulus in N. pinetum, second-to-last in N. lecontei -> ventral curve + annulus record
old_dropped.14: N. lecontei: annulus 9; N. pinetum: pre-apical notch. Not the same structure -> removed from the fixed set
old_dropped.25: annulus 1 "most proximal part above the rachis": worst inter-observer error (19 um median), 74% across-outline
old_dropped.26: annulus 2 equivalent of 25: 12 um median error; D2 (old 24) already marks annulus 2 dorsally
old_dropped.32: annulus 8 dorsal end: same count problem as 13 -> annulus record

annulus_record: For every complete annulus (1..n, n usually 8 in N. pinetum and 9 in N. lecontei), record (a) its crossing of the rachis curve as arc-length distance from the apex S01 in mm (the coordinate shared with the lance, whose sutures are recorded the same way along its interface edge), and (b) its ventral end V_k as an arc-length fraction of the ventral outline V1 -> S01. n and the spacings are phenotypes in their own right; they are not part of the Procrustes configuration.
